eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Intelligent and Sustainable Computing Systems (ICISCS 2026) aims to provide a comprehensive platform for examining the convergence of intelligent technologies and sustainable computing paradigms to address contemporary global challenges. With rapid digital transformation across sectors, there is a growing demand for computing systems that are not only intelligent and high-performing but also energy-efficient, environmentally responsible, and socially inclusive.
